svg.title: WOSSOL complete visual identity system proposal V0.1 — unapproved concept
svg.desc: Latin-first proposed visual system based on provisional A Clear Stroke wordmark, Evidence Thread graphic grammar, tested palette, proposed licensed typography and six realistic illustrative applications. Compact mark remains unresolved; any W avatar is explicitly temporary.
svg.text: WOSSOL · VISUAL IDENTITY SYSTEM PROPOSAL · V0.1
PROVISIONAL PRIMARY WORDMARK · A / CLEAR STROKE
A visual system for context that stays close
as commerce work moves between people and steps.
A design proposal grounded in connected records, bounded agency
and evidence-aware operations — not a promise of total coverage.
Wossol's strongest repeated product pattern is not a single tool;
it is selected commercial context remaining connected, with fact boundaries visible.
THE EVIDENCE THREAD · COMPOSITION DEVICE, NOT A LOGO OR CLAIM OF A CLOSED LOOP
Use a solid thread only where the record relationship exists; show a deliberate gap or unresolved marker where evidence is missing.
No arrows, global maps, growth curves or decorative network meshes. Never imply causal attribution or complete lifecycle coverage.
02 · FUNCTIONAL COLOR SYSTEM · PROPOSED / NOT APPROVED
VERIFIED WCAG 2.2 AA TEXT PAIRS · NORMAL TEXT THRESHOLD 4.5:1
Harbor / Paper 11.29:1 · Night / Paper 14.76:1 · Harbor / Lime 9.64:1 · White / Harbor 12.22:1 · Slate / Paper 4.72:1
Dark text / Coral 4.66:1. Blue / Paper 4.24:1 FAILS for normal text: reserve for non-text/large type. Ratios calculated from sRGB tokens; re-test final components.
03 · TYPOGRAPHY · PROPOSED PAIR, LICENSE CHECKED, LOCAL AVAILABILITY NOT MET
Use tabular figures for data; avoid all-caps paragraphs. Screen-first, clear x-height.
ARABIC SUPPORT · NOTO SANS ARABIC VARIABLE · SIL OFL 1.1
وضوحٌ في السياق، ومجالٌ لقرار التاجر.
RTL layout mirrors reading order, not the brand mark. Arabic custom lettering remains deferred.
Inter and Noto Sans Arabic are proposed and OFL 1.1 license files were checked. Neither font is installed in this workspace; specimen rendering uses system fallback.
Before rollout: install/package approved font files, preserve required license notices, inspect shaping/diacritics and test real Arabic/Latin mixed strings.
Only when the source is present
Composition: 12-column marketing grid / 4px UI base / 8–16–24–32–48 spacing. Open panels, thin dividers, one strong rail, sparse signal color.
05 · APPLICATIONS · ONE VISUAL SYSTEM ACROSS PUBLIC AND OPERATIONAL TOUCHPOINTS
Explore how Wossol brings selected order and operational context
into a clearer working view. Scope varies by workflow and connection.
Illustrative record · no live merchant data
CONCEPT COPY · PRODUCT CLAIMS REQUIRE FINAL PRODUCT/LEGAL REVIEW
02 · MERCHANT DASHBOARD · ILLUSTRATIVE DATA / NO LIVE METRICS
Selected order context · illustrative record data
03 · MOBILE WORKSPACE CONCEPT · RESPONSIVE SCOPE UNVERIFIED
PRODUCT PARITY / OFFLINE BEHAVIOR NOT ASSERTED
DO NOT DEPLOY AS FINAL APP ICON
Use A wordmark only; reserve clearspace ≥ 0.25× cap height; target digital minimum width 112px.
Use mono Harbor on Paper or Paper on Night. Lime is an accent, not the default wordmark fill.
Recheck print, low-resolution, browser and 1× displays before adoption. No lockup or icon is final.
ALL APPLICATIONS ARE DESIGN CONCEPTS · SYNTHETIC INTERFACE RECORDS · NO LIVE CUSTOMER DATA · NO OWNER APPROVAL
ARABIC CUSTOM LETTERING DEFERRED · SUPPORTING TYPOGRAPHY PROPOSED
